lore: 中央庭曾把疏散、救治、配给与城市重建接续成一项长期责任。进入星海后，这种经验成为各殖民地能够共同调用的恢复方法：防卫仍在继续时，工场也可以开始修复生活与生产所依赖的环境。
application: 建设灾后重建工场。殖民地荒废度至少10时，投入一份已备物资、500能源和200消费品，开展全国同时一处的重建项目。每个有效月度降低5点荒废度，最多6次；低于5时提前收尾，余量按原生机制恢复。失控、轰炸或工场停用时暂停，保留进度；危机期间可用。

project.stock: one local acs_supply_reserved of original owner; existing pack = 500 minerals/100 alloys
project.payment: script guard/debit once; no native decision cost/discount refund loophole
project.guard: safe controlled active workshop, F05 research, real stock/damage/balance; nation no ongoing or paused reconstruction
project.monthly: only at valid own safe workshop, subtract 5 devastation if >=5 and increment work once
project.finish: work >=6 or current devastation <5; preserve actual work, release national slot, add empty local acr_rebuild_done
project.natural_recovery: not overwritten; if already healed before monthly, finish with no invented work or reward
project.remaining_damage: may remain after six months; <5 left to natural recovery; another paid round needs >=10
project.ordinary_stock_after_start: independent; new stock neither consumed monthly nor cleared by cancel
project.pause: occupation/bombardment/workshop or research loss: keep payment/work/nation slot; no catch-up
project.cancel: original owner can cancel even occupied or facility/research absent, no refund/rollback of real healing
project.transfer_or_destroy: existing ACS clear removes project/receipt/work, no resource refund, prior real healing remains

interface.receipt: local original-owner record, not victory or permanent country benefit

performance.monthly: guard within existing ACS carrier iteration, no new galaxy scan

sources.constraint: 中央庭灾后公共协调、救援与普通工业支撑为背景；具体跨星际重建/费用/荒废度效果属于Mod设计，不量产神器或复原已死亡人口。

native_reference.reference: 本机4.5.2 script_documentation：planet_devastation、add_planet_devastation；既有格蕾莎入口也以真实荒废度筛选，但人物源码未改
native_reference.devastation_effect: apply -5 only when current >=5; finish at <5; no dependence on negative clamp
native_reference.repair: building ruins use normal native queues; no repair_building/repair_all_buildings
native_reference.scope: planet/carrier local damage and progress; owner resources

limitations: 仅验证结构和项目内显式引用，不验证原版触发器、效果、作用域、数值平衡或事件可达性。
未校验引擎隐式岗位、修正、trait、outliner 图标；须以最新冷启动日志和游戏内显示验收。
未运行游戏；静态 pass 不能变更 runtime_status，也不能代替存档及日志证据。

validation.fixture_note: 执行正式普通物资支付/库存消费、项目决议及ACS月度；荒废度为现场输入，原生自然恢复不模拟。比较与作用域严格求值。
limitations: 原生建造、荒废度变化/自然恢复并行、界面和实际存读档未验。
33项为源码检查，日期/损伤夹具不是自然事件或游戏内验证。

runtime.priority: 集中试玩仍优先D12，F05只取一个真实受损殖民地的付费/暂停恢复片段，共用关键读档，不逐包重测。
